name: @fruitbars/xfyun-ai-mcp-darwin-arm64
description: XFYun AI MCP native binary for macOS arm64

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'), p='bin/xfyun-ai-mcp'; if(!fs.statSync(p).isFile()||fs.statSync(p).size===0) throw Error('Missing native binary'); fs.accessSync(p, fs.constants.X_OK)"
